Which setting wins when the same option is set in the project config, an environment variable, a command-line flag and my organization's admin config?

text:
The user is asking about the precedence order of configuration settings in Mistral's platform when the same option is defined in multiple places: project config, environment variable, command-line flag, and organization admin config. They want to know which one takes precedence.

I need to find the documentation that explains the configuration hierarchy or precedence rules. Let me search for relevant terms in the Mistral documentation.

Let me search for configuration precedence or hierarchy information.

content.text:
The **command-line flag** wins.

All other sources (environment variable, project config, organization admin config) are overridden by a command-line flag when the same option is specified in multiple places.

[Configuration precedence](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/configuration#configuration-precedence)
